Lucent Client is a Fabric client mod for Minecraft Java Edition, with a desktop launcher.

### Mod
Supports Minecraft 26.1 to 26.3. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API, then put the jar
for your version into `mods`:

| Minecraft | File |
|---|---|
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `lucentclient-*+26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.2 | `lucentclient-*+26.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `lucentclient-*+26.3.jar` |

Press Right Shift in game to open the menu.

### Launcher
- Windows: `Lucent.Launcher_*_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`)
- macOS (Apple silicon and Intel): `Lucent.Launcher_*_universal.dmg`
- Linux: `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm`

This is a pre-release. Microsoft sign-in in the launcher is waiting for Mojang to approve the app, so
the launcher can't start the game yet; use the mod jars with any launcher in the meantime.
The launcher isn't code-signed: Windows SmartScreen will ask for confirmation, and on macOS open it
with right-click, Open.
